description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementReport class, a controller within the OrangeHRM system's leave module. It handles the setup of data and components for the leave entitlement report view, including retrieving subunits, locations, and leave periods, and preparing a Vue.js component with this data.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing and rendering the leave entitlement report view with relevant data.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with subunits, locations, and leave period data before rendering the view.
